It repairs recent failure regions for multifunctional oxygenated compounds, nitro carbonyl loading interactions, sulfur oxidation-state transfer, nitrogen-subfamily response, and fused-aromatic alcohols. Several groups form matched curves across PE/EA ratio, loading amount, or loading solvent, allowing retraining to learn slopes and interactions for V1 and V2 separately. Other selections add structurally related families with different carbonyl, nitrogen, sulfur, or aromatic environments to test transfer beyond the exact measured molecule. The combination should improve Row-distribution accuracy by covering high-error regions, distinguishing competing chemical explanations, and supplying labels where current predictions are both structurally novel and strongly inconsistent with nearby measured behavior. Loading amount is interpreted only as density times volume; no unrecorded concentration, flow, pH, or column variables are assumed."}
